philippines.description:

philippines.title: DA Ilocos to provide fuel subsidy to qualified agri truck operators
philippines.description:
STO. DOMINGO, Ilocos Sur — Owners and operators of qualified agricultural trucks in the Ilocos Region may apply for fuel subsidy assistance through a registration caravan scheduled by the Department of Agriculture (DA) on Nov. 20 at the Farmers’ Productivity Center in this town. The subsidy is intended to help reduce fuel expenses and ease the cost of transporting agricultural products and essential farm inputs, supporting truck operators involved in moving goods across the region. philippines.title: 7 hurt after vehicle plunges down slope in Baguio City
philippines.description:
BAGUIO CITY — Seven people, including two minors, were rushed to a hospital after the vehicle they were riding in plunged down a slope in Barangay Salud Mitra here on Saturday (Nov. 14). The driver’s wife said nine people were aboard the vehicle and were on their way back to their hotel when the accident happened.
